name: deepagentforecast
description: DeepAgentForecast — one prompt: deep research → knowledge graph → multi-agent simulation → forecast

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend

scripts.check:env: cd backend && uv run python scripts/check_env_drift.py --strict
